name: antigravity-auto-accept
description: Automatically accept supported Antigravity IDE agent approval buttons on Windows. No debug port or command allowlist setup.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Auto-accept runs only in a trusted workspace.

antigravityAutoAccept.autoStart.description: Start the auto-accept scanner automatically when the extension activates.

antigravityAutoAccept.pollMs.description: How often the Windows UIAutomation scanner looks for permission buttons, in milliseconds.

antigravityAutoAccept.cooldownMs.description: Minimum delay after an approval action attempt before the scanner can act again, in milliseconds.

antigravityAutoAccept.restoreCursor.description: Include a cursor restore in the same verified input batch as a fallback physical click.

antigravityAutoAccept.showNotifications.description: Show VS Code notifications when the scanner is started, stopped, toggled, or restarted.

scripts.test:concurrency: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -OutputFormat Text -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $testPath=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('./tests/scanner-concurrency.test.ps1'); $tokens=$null; $errors=$null; $ast=[Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput([IO.File]::ReadAllText($testPath,[Text.Encoding]::UTF8),$testPath,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors); if($errors.Count){throw 'Concurrency test parse failed'}; & $ast.GetScriptBlock()"
scripts.test:scanner: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -OutputFormat Text -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $testPath=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('./tests/scanner.test.ps1'); $tokens=$null; $errors=$null; $ast=[Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput([IO.File]::ReadAllText($testPath,[Text.Encoding]::UTF8),$testPath,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors); if($errors.Count){throw 'Scanner test parse failed'}; & $ast.GetScriptBlock()"
scripts.test:mouse: powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -OutputFormat Text -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$ProgressPreference='SilentlyContinue'; $testPath=[IO.Path]::GetFullPath('./tests/mouse-helper.test.ps1'); $tokens=$null; $errors=$null; $ast=[Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseInput([IO.File]::ReadAllText($testPath,[Text.Encoding]::UTF8),$testPath,[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors); if($errors.Count){throw 'Mouse helper test parse failed'}; & $ast.GetScriptBlock()"
